posts.title: Tree-ZPS VMC1060 with Siemens PC2100 control for sale. $5750.
posts.text: Vertical Milling Machine Center with Siemens 2100 CNC control and 24 ATC umbrella-style tool changer. CAT40 spindle with max 8000 RPMs. Manufactured to hold tight tolerances. Machine runs smoothly and will last for decades more if properly maintained. Great machine at a great price to start or add to an existing machine shop. At this price, you could even buy it... Read more
posts.author: Mark_ZPS

drafts.no_link: For a used machine like this, the usual routes are Facebook Marketplace, Craigslist, a local dealer or an auction if it's big iron. We run YardSwaps, a free marketplace just for used work equipment, so that's one more place to list it at no cost (no fee, no cut, buyer picks up and pays you). Clear photos of the data plate and hours help on any site. What's the condition on it?
